snippet.title: Queen Must Die - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Queen Must Die - 3d horror set in dark fantasy world. Rule your empire by day and explore your castle by night. Uncover the royal family's sinister secrets and confront the horrors seeking to destroy you. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4787430/Queen_Must_Die/

Developer: Team Must Live
